title: Release logical hosting accounts from verified v12 baseline
problem: The old candidate expects v10, while the existing function is v12. Actual source comparison proves unchanged bytes, but the exact version guard must be refreshed before release.
expected_behavior: Release unchanged product source 1dee65da7b68f12d147d11e3f02befae06416ef2 with refreshed manifest SHA256 ebef1ee3c0e2084a3b449fd4b9071c410d62a7f121b9e5671c96999f9ecaed10. Target sandy-customer-provisioning-api existing v12, preserve verify_jwt=true and all unchanged deployed modules. Apply only migrations 20261024010000 and 20261024010010; keep operation exposure disabled. Expected candidate v13 and function rollback v14. No gateway/provider/runtime deployment, paid infrastructure, DNS, traffic, IAM, credential or delegation changes. Preserve all customer/account/audit data on rollback. Protected executor must independently verify this genuine Owner audit, exact live preimage, source CI, component lease and recovery artifact before dispatch.
change_purpose: Refresh the stale v10 hosting release candidate after verifying all six live v12 module digests and the reported bundle digest match the original baseline. Supersedes proposal 04fab547-3177-4eb4-ac23-23831152b420 for execution; preserves its history.
feature_improvement: Enable non-billable tenant-bound logical account create/get with existing customer identity, idempotency and audit; no provider provisioning.
acceptance_criteria: Verify exact v12 source/module and bundle digests, immutable candidate source and manifest
Apply additive account schema and inactive contracts through the bounded protected executor
Verify deployed candidate modules/JWT and capture real release receipts without claiming customer acceptance
Coordinate gateway availability and real verified sandy.chat owner-session canary separately
regression_rules: Supersedes stale proposal 04fab547-3177-4eb4-ac23-23831152b420 for dispatch; never manufacture or reuse its approval
Preserve existing data and unchanged source bytes; rollback function only with exact candidate preimage
Do not deploy shared gateway/provider/runtime services or change their registrations
No new paid resources, credentials, IAM, DNS, traffic or persistent grants
No automatic replay of uncertain writes; reconcile before further action
